title: The Non-Compensable Rights Floors Architecture
scopeLimits: Illustrates the 5 essential rights floors that cannot be traded away for price or volume discounts.

accessibility.altText: A foundational diagram showing five non-compensable rights pillars: Exit, Contestability, Intelligibility, Privacy, and Outside Option Fallback supporting legitimate collective market formation.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Five non-compensable pillars: 1. Unconditional Exit, 2. Continuous Contestability, 3. Constraint Intelligibility, 4. Telemetry Privacy, 5. Outside Option Equivalence. These underpin voluntary market formation.
